correctness.rationale: Incidence edge space of a cactus has exactly one disjoint support relation per cycle, so its P_G=conv±b_e is a linear image of the free sum of each centered cycle-vertex configuration u_i=e_i−1/ℓ and independent bridge segments. Polar is product Q_ℓ={y∈Hℓ:|y_i|≤1}×bridge intervals. Every Qℓ vertex has norm² kℓ=ℓ for even ℓ, or ℓ−1 for odd ℓ; the exact facet count follows. Symmetry and uniqueness force block-scalar extremal shapes. John determinant optimization under single budget Σkℓ aℓ+Σt_bridge≤1 yields aℓ=(ℓ−1)/(d kℓ), t=1/d, transporting to Σ_J weighted Laplacian. Löwner independent outer-vertex constraints yield aℓ=(ℓ−1)/ℓ, t=1, transporting to Σ_L. All polar vertices attain John support equality; all signed generating edge roots meet Löwner boundary, and strict convexity excludes other points. Block determinant ratio gives d^{d/2}∏(kℓ/ℓ)^((ℓ−1)/2); matching block ratios gives precise homothety classification. Weighted matrix-tree identity gives individual volumes. Finite 61-cactus checker explicitly confirms 26,006 facet contacts and 998 signed vertex contacts; it cannot prove all cacti. Proof valid even single-bridge graph and multiple articulation cycles.
